_handoff.scopeNote: Official-source pass for a new BWSSB water-supply and underground-drainage connection in Bengaluru. Sources are limited to BWSSB-owned public pages and BWSSB-hosted manuals/documents. No login, OTP, property lookup, document upload, application, grievance, payment, or other live submission was made. Claims distinguish current public-page observations from manual/FAQ guidance and preserve unresolved currentness or property-specific questions.

documentationShelf.title: BWSSB Jaladhare consumer public entry
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: Current public entry for mobile-OTP access, application-number status lookup, high-level new-connection instructions, document classes, charge categories, and displayed status-table headings.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: Unauthenticated page does not expose a property-specific form, eligibility decision, application number, demand amount, review result, or connection completion. The page also carries a legacy demand-note notice whose applicability is not established.

documentationShelf.title: BWSSB Consumer User Manual — Jaladhare 3.0
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: Official manual screenshots and instructions for the Consumer Details, Site Details, Building Details, Documents, Review, and Payment screens, including visible fields, documents, tentative charge categories, demand-note conditions, and receipt flow.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: The PDF is a manual/example rather than a property-specific live transaction. It does not prove that all fields, validations, amounts, or conditions apply to every connection type or that the current portal exactly matches every illustrated state.

documentationShelf.title: BWSSB Jaladhare public More Information page
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: Publicly listed document classes: building plan, lease-cum-sale deed, building photograph with owner, khata, and conditional OC/RWH/STP photographs.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: The page is separate from the current owcv2 consumer entry and does not resolve which conditional documents are required for a particular application.

documentationShelf.title: BWSSB public Important Docs page
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: Public links for application, attachment, inspection, deposit, prorata, GBWASP/BCC and related references.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: The public index does not itself supply a case-specific fee total, demand note, or application outcome.

documentationShelf.title: BWSSB Jaladhare FAQ
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: Official guidance on registration/login, the application fee route, saving drafts, stage/designation status, ward/service-area routing, inspection contact, registered plumber and mutual agreement, demand-note timing, final payment, and support contacts.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: The FAQ uses a registered-email/password SAJALA flow while the current public consumer page uses mobile OTP; fee and contact statements therefore require current-route confirmation.

documentationShelf.title: BWSSB public grievance form
documentationShelf.whatItCovers: Visible grievance fields for consumer name/mobile, subject, application number/name, address, plumber name, remarks, plus 1916 and an email shown on the page.
documentationShelf.whereItStops: No grievance was submitted, so acknowledgement, routing, response time, and recovery outcomes are unknown.

claims.text: The current public Jaladhare consumer entry says a new connection applicant should log in with a mobile number, pay to buy the application form, fill the application and upload documents, and use the same mobile number to know application status.
claims.notes: Direct unauthenticated page text. No mobile number, OTP, payment, or application was entered.

claims.text: The current Jaladhare public page lists lease-cum-sale deed or sale deed, khata certificate, building/sanction plan, photograph of the building with owner, and an RWH adoption document for premises measuring 1200 square feet and above as document classes for a new connection.
claims.notes: This is a public checklist, not proof that every item is required for every connection type. The separate More Information page also lists conditional OC and STP photos; the public pages do not reconcile those variants.

claims.text: The current Jaladhare public page exposes charge categories for application, attachment, inspection, three-month minimum deposit, meter, sanitary points, GBWASP/BCC, prorata, and actual line cost; it also links connection-fee references.
claims.notes: No fixed total or property-specific rate is asserted. The public page does not calculate a case-specific demand without application context.

claims.text: As observed on 2026-08-28, the public Jaladhare page displayed a status table for permission for a new or additional water/underground-drainage connection with headings of 14 days for residential connections and 42 days for commercial and high-rise connections.
claims.notes: These are displayed target headings, not an unconditional service-level promise. The table metrics were blank in the public observation and the trigger for the clock is not stated.

claims.text: The official consumer manual describes a five-stage new-connection interface: Consumer Details, Site Details, Building Details, Documents, and Review.
claims.notes: Direct reading of the official manual's page descriptions; not a claim that the current unauthenticated page exposes all five screens.

claims.text: The official manual describes consumer/connection fields including applicant contact and communication address, connection pincode/service area/service station/division/subdivision/ward, existing BWSSB connection and RR number, and BESCOM account verification; its site screen includes PID/khata, construction date, purpose, flat/toilet counts where applicable, sital and built-up area, and NOC/RWH/OC information.
claims.notes: Manual examples and guidance; PID verification is described as optional in the manual material, while property-specific validation and requiredness remain untested.

claims.text: The official manual describes floor-by-floor building details with purpose/type and amenity or parking information, and a plumber section where a plumber can be selected; it states that when RWH is marked yes, plumber selection and mutual agreement are mandatory.
claims.notes: The manual describes interface behavior; it does not establish the exact current plumber-validation or RWH rule for every property.

claims.text: The official manual describes uploads for building plan, building photograph with owner, lease-cum-sale deed, and khata; it lists road-cutting endorsement when applicable and says up to five documents per type may be uploaded with a five-MB file-size limit.
claims.notes: Manual upload instructions; no files were selected or transmitted. Conditional OC/RWH/STP documents appear on a separate official page and are not treated as universal.

claims.text: The official manual's Review screen describes tentative charges based on the entered inputs, with prorata, standard, and GBWASP/BCC tables, a total payable display, and a declaration that incorrect information may lead to rejection.
claims.notes: The manual's sample amounts are masked/illustrative and no case-specific calculation was run.

claims.text: The official manual describes a demand note after connection approval, conditional completion of RWH and, where applicable, STP/dual piping, KSPCB consent, and additional billing until OC; it says the demand note is valid for 90 days, payment is online through Cashfree or PayU, and a receipt is generated after successful payment.
claims.notes: Manual/demand-note wording, not a property-specific obligation or approval. It also says plumbing works are to be executed by a BWSSB-licensed plumber; no payment or work order was initiated.

claims.text: BWSSB's FAQ says applications can be saved as drafts, status can show stage and designation, ward/service-area selection routes an application to a concerned sub-division AEE, engineers may contact the registered number and pre-inform an inspection visit, and after inspection a demand note is raised for charges such as prorata and GBWASP.
claims.notes: Official FAQ guidance. It is not a live case observation and uses a registered-email/password route that differs from the current public mobile-OTP entry.

claims.text: BWSSB's FAQ says the plumber should be BWSSB-registered, a consumer may change plumber details before final payment, and a scanned consumer/registered-plumber agreement should be attached before final payment.
claims.notes: Published FAQ statement; exact current enforcement and connection-type exceptions are not tested.

claims.text: The BWSSB public grievance page exposes consumer/mobile, subject, application number/name, address, plumber name, and remarks fields, and displays toll-free 1916 and an email contact.
claims.notes: Only the public form is verified; no grievance was submitted and no response time or routing was observed.

claims.text: The reviewed official materials do not establish a complete current, property-specific sequence from mobile OTP and application-form purchase through document acceptance, inspection, demand-note approval, payment verification, RR-number generation, and physical water/UGD connection.
claims.notes: Public pages and manual describe separate stages and outcomes, but the pass did not authenticate, submit, or observe a case-specific transition.

claims.text: A current fixed total for a new Bengaluru BWSSB water/UGD connection cannot be derived from the reviewed public pages alone; the pages expose charge categories and references but the demand depends on property, building, connection, and other parameters.
claims.notes: Do not substitute citizen-reported or agent-quoted totals for an official demand note.

claims.text: The relationship between the current mobile-OTP Jaladhare public entry and the FAQ's older registered-email/password SAJALA instructions is unresolved by the reviewed official pages.
claims.notes: This is a route/currentness limitation, not a finding that either page is false.
